# Why Fixed Layouts Break on Small Screens

#### Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen

## Why Fixed Layouts Break on Small Screens

Your portfolio was built for a desktop screen. That's fine, that's where you designed it. But a desktop screen is usually 1200px wide or more. A phone is somewhere around 360 to 390px.

That's less than a third of the space.

![Same layout. Small screens break it.](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

See the difference?

The nav is spilling off the screen. The hero is trying to fit two things side by side where there's only room for one. The stat cards are squeezed so tight the text is barely readable.

Nothing in your code is wrong. It was just written assuming a wide screen, and on a narrow one those assumptions fall apart.
